notes.notes: With update 2.1 you can now choose two characters with a single control in training mode ... incredible but it took us 6 years to add that. Sorry.

notes.title: COMBATE MONERO VERSION 2.0
notes.notes:
After a long time working on that, we want to announce that we finally finished the translation of Combate Monero into English! so people from many more places in the world will be able to meet and get closer to these wonderful characters from the Mexican comic books!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917749/0fa4b60d8b2db290989a5638810b47fdc796b777.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917749/bbdf27886a31c44a406e8287fbb8970122eab683.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Three new voices for Combate
notes.notes:
The letter M, Ba'al and Pepe will be the lucky ones who will be able to scream at the top of their lungs with the new monero combat expansion in which they will finally have a voice. This is a small update and we want to remind you that we are still working on the translation of the title into English, please stay tuned and thank you very much for supporting Combate all this time.

Special thanks to the Mexaverso page for helping us record the voices.

https://campeonesjusticieros.blogspot.com

https://www.facebook.com/Mexaverso/

notes.title: Combate Monero will soon be availabe in english!
notes.notes:
That's right, since we are a very small team and we are doing several things along with the development of the game and other projects, we have not been able to focus on the translation of the title into English, with which we could get closer to many more people around the world .

It has been a somewhat slow process but we hope to have the system ready to exchange between Spanish and English quickly!

thank you for your patience.

notes.title: Actualización 1.9.9.5
notes.notes: En este update podrán escuchar la voz de cuatro personajes, Crámil, Fátima, Lobaberta y El Maizo!

notes.title: VIKA JOINS THE COMBATE!
notes.notes:
Vika, creation of El Chico Detergente, joins the Combate Monero as the last female fighter to enter the roster. Loaded with a wealth of electronic weapons, she will fight to find love!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917749/86d3b75777878c7489e595bd5674ec893b9239ea.png[/img]

Vika will arrive on the new update that will be up on December 25!

Plus some new trophies are added for those who like to unlock achievements and a couple of adjustments and balances!

[url=https://chicodetergente.com]Here you can learn more about Vika and her Author![/url]

notes.title: MIni update
notes.notes:
We made a mini update to fix some errors we came across while developing the last one, and added a new Achievement "Para que sirve esa barra" wich you can unlock by performing 100 super moves.

Thanks!

notes.title: Almost Ready!
notes.notes:
Good Evening everyone! The Combate Monero Page has just been approved by Steam so the game will be available on may 3rd 2019!

We are still hard at work polishing things and doing some last minute fixes.

Please take notice that this is Combate Monero v.1.0,and we'll keep on updating the game, adding characters, balances, game modes and maybe some other stuff.

[b]Thanks for the support![/b]
